independent_findings.title: FindCareApp UI Bypass Silently Deactivates Six Backend Capabilities
independent_findings.evidence: FindCareApp.tsx only calls /classify and /search, never /chat. All chat-loop-only features (consent, lead capture, unknown question, About, clinical trials, session lock) are unreachable from the main UI. Confirmed by code and architecture.json.
independent_findings.description: The currently mounted UI (FindCareApp) bypasses the /chat endpoint, making six backend capabilities unreachable: HIPAA consent, lead capture, unknown question recording, About ChatHealthy, clinical trials, and session lock. No bug or story documents this full scope.

independent_findings.title: State/Specialty Context Carry-Forward Regression
independent_findings.evidence: FindCareApp.tsx is stateless; each /classify call is independent. work_log.json ASN-3C7F91 requires context carry-forward. No code or bug tracks this regression.
independent_findings.description: The requirement to carry state/specialty context across conversational turns is broken in FindCareApp. Each search is stateless, breaking a documented requirement.

independent_findings.title: UMLS CPT Code Compliance Work In Progress — Legal Pre-Launch Blocker
independent_findings.evidence: BUG-LEGAL-001 open in bugs.json; agile_backlog.json UMLS-COMPLIANCE story accepted.
independent_findings.description: CPT codes are restricted by UMLS license. Compliance work is in progress but not closed. This is a legal blocker for public launch.

independent_findings.title: ChatWindow.tsx Retirement: Undocumented Architectural Decision Abandoning Four UI Capabilities
independent_findings.evidence: ChatWindow.tsx exists but is not mounted. App.tsx (not found, but confirmed by prior audit and manifest) mounts FindCareApp. No formal deprecation story.
independent_findings.description: ChatWindow.tsx implemented chat UX features (markdown, session lock, emergency lock, response time) that are not present in FindCareApp. Its retirement is not formally documented.

independent_findings.title: URL Guardian Dead-Coded: Hallucinated URLs Can Reach Users
independent_findings.evidence: url_guardian.py exists and is functional, but dead code audit (ai_operations.json) marks guard_tool_result and check_url as dead. No active call sites in main.py.
independent_findings.description: URL validation is implemented but not wired into active tool call or LLM response paths. Hallucinated or broken URLs can reach users.

independent_findings.title: Regex Specialty Fallback Removed — No Safety Net for Missing Vector Index
independent_findings.evidence: specialty_service.py is vector-only. No regex fallback. Confirmed by code and commit history.
independent_findings.description: Specialty lookup now relies solely on vector search. If the vector index is missing or broken, there is no fallback, leading to silent failures.

independent_findings.title: Specialty Ranker Built, Disabled, Dead-Coded — No Formal Decision
independent_findings.evidence: ai_operations.json DC-003; specialty_ranker.py dead-coded; no backlog story for restoration or retirement.
independent_findings.description: A specialty ranker was built but is dead-coded and not formally retired or restored. The feature is in limbo.

independent_findings.title: LLM Narrative Response and Markdown Rendering Inaccessible from FindCareApp
independent_findings.evidence: FindCareApp.tsx does not render LLM chat responses or markdown. Only provider cards are shown. No bug or story documents this gap.
independent_findings.description: Users cannot receive narrative LLM responses or markdown explanations in FindCareApp. This is a silent UX regression.

independent_findings.title: HuggingFace Deployment Uses Bearer Tokens Instead of mTLS
independent_findings.evidence: BUG-SEC-001 open in bugs.json; agile_backlog.json SEC-MTLS stories accepted.
independent_findings.description: HuggingFace Spaces deployment uses bearer tokens for authentication instead of mTLS. This is a documented security gap.

independent_findings.title: Brain Loop Dead-Coded — MongoDB Migration Backlog Item Abandoned Without Story
independent_findings.evidence: ai_operations.json DC-019 through DC-031; work_log.json ASN-6D0265; no formal backlog story.
independent_findings.description: Brain loop functions for assignment queue and review pipeline are dead-coded. MongoDB migration was never completed or formally retired.

independent_findings.title: Dynamic Context Loading Not Implemented — Inefficient All-Load on Every Request
independent_findings.evidence: work_log.json ASN-F5801E defines requirement; main.py loads all me/ context on every request.
independent_findings.description: Context documents are loaded on every request regardless of intent, causing inefficiency. No bug or story tracks this.

independent_findings.title: Google Maps Provider Location Map Never Implemented
independent_findings.description: Google Maps integration was a stretch goal and never implemented. Not a regression.

independent_findings.title: EvaluateCare Scoring Engine, Clinical Trial Scoring, Rx Analysis, and Weight Adjustment Not Built
independent_findings.evidence: agile_backlog.json EVAL-SCORE-PROV, EVAL-SP-001 through EVAL-SP-003, EVAL-SCORE-CT, EVAL-CT-MEASURE-1 through 7, EVAL-P-RX, EVAL-WEIGHTS; design.json has specs.
independent_findings.description: These features are fully designed and accepted in the backlog but not yet built. Not a regression.

comparison_with_prior_audit.reasoning: All evidence matches. UI bypass is confirmed.
UMLS CPT compliance is a legal blocker and is open.
ChatWindow.tsx is unmounted and not formally retired.
URL Guardian is dead-coded and not wired in.
Regex fallback is removed; vector-only confirmed.
Specialty ranker is dead-coded and not formally decided.
LLM narrative response is not rendered in FindCareApp.
HF bearer token vs mTLS gap is documented and open.
Brain loop dead code and migration gap confirmed.
Dynamic context loading is not implemented.
EvaluateCare scoring and related features are not built.
